tasks.description:

1. Run `grep -rn "hl/v2/credit" .` across the whole repo (all extensions, including docs.json, *.mdx, api-reference/openapi.json, snippets, and any guide pages). Record the complete occurrence list.
2. Expected baseline (verify it matches): 21 occurrences across exactly 7 files, all under api-reference-v2/credit/ - add-credit.mdx, balance.mdx, generate-immutable-checkout.mdx, paginate-credit-history.mdx, regist-credit-usage.mdx, regist-membership.mdx, spend.mdx. Each page has 3: the curl line inside <RequestExample>, the Production URL (api.mayar.id) and the Sandbox URL (api.mayar.io) inside the Endpoint <CodeGroup>.
3. Cross-check the target prefix form against the V1 credit pages: grep for "credit/v1/credit" under api-reference/creditbasedproduct/ and api-reference/usagebasedmembership/ and confirm the shape is https://api.mayar.id/credit/v1/credit/<suffix>. The V2 target is therefore https://api.mayar.id/credit/v2/credit/<suffix> - same suffixes, only the host prefix changes.
4. Record the exact route suffix each of the 7 pages must keep unchanged: /customer/balance, /customer/spend, /customer/add-credit, /customer/paginate-credit-history/(customerId) with its query string, /membership/customer/regist, /credit-usage/customer/regist, /generate/immutable/checkout.

Acceptance criteria: a written occurrence inventory (file:line for all 21) appended to .jonggrang/.output/features/fix-v2-credit-endpoint-base-path-mt18vmcz/progress.txt, an explicit statement that no occurrence exists outside api-reference-v2/credit/ (or, if one does, it is listed and flagged for the plan owner), and confirmation of the credit/vN/credit/ prefix form from the V1 pages. If the inventory deviates from the expected baseline, note the deviation rather than silently proceeding. No files modified in this task.

tasks.title: Rewrite base path on the four customer-scoped credit pages
tasks.description:
Apply the host-prefix correction hl/v2/credit -> credit/v2/credit on these four pages, 3 occurrences each (12 total):

- api-reference-v2/credit/balance.mdx - line ~10 curl (GET, api.mayar.id), ~63 Production, ~67 Sandbox. Suffix stays /customer/balance?customerId=(customerId)&productId=(productId).
- api-reference-v2/credit/spend.mdx - ~10 curl (POST), ~41 Production, ~45 Sandbox. Suffix stays /customer/spend.
- api-reference-v2/credit/add-credit.mdx - ~10 curl (POST), ~41 Production, ~45 Sandbox. Suffix stays /customer/add-credit.
- api-reference-v2/credit/paginate-credit-history.mdx - ~10 curl (GET), ~64 Production, ~68 Sandbox. Suffix stays /customer/paginate-credit-history/... with its query string intact. Note the curl uses a concrete UUID example while the CodeGroup uses (customerId)/(productId) placeholders - preserve each form exactly.

Rules:
- Change ONLY the path segment hl/v2/credit -> credit/v2/credit. Both hosts get the change: api.mayar.id (Production) and api.mayar.io (Sandbox).
- Do not touch frontmatter (including the openapi: identifier), titles, descriptions, parameter tables, headers, request/response bodies, error sections, or any example UUIDs and query values.
- Do not add notes, callouts, or restructure the pages.
- Preferred mechanism: a targeted sed -i substitution of hl/v2/credit to credit/v2/credit per file, since the string is unambiguous and appears only in URL positions.

Acceptance criteria: grepping for hl/v2/credit in balance.mdx, spend.mdx, add-credit.mdx and paginate-credit-history.mdx returns nothing; grepping for credit/v2/credit across the same four files returns exactly 12 lines (4 curl + 4 Production + 4 Sandbox); git diff --stat shows only these 4 files touched and git diff shows only URL-line changes.
